convencao_de_pagina: NEO4J p.N = PDF page (=== PAGE N === markers); printed page = N - 18

lpg.title: Labeled property graph (LPG) model
lpg.summary: Nodes with properties and labels; named, directed relationships with a start and end node and properties.

ifa.title: Index-free adjacency (IFA) and costs
ifa.summary: Each node holds direct references to its neighbors; the book cites O(log n) vs O(1) per hop and O(m log n) vs O(m) for m steps; it does not use k^d.

benchmark.title: Table 2-1: friends of friends, RDBMS vs Neo4j
benchmark.summary: 1,000,000 people, ~50 friends; RDBMS 0.016 / 30.267 / 1543.505 s / unfinished; Neo4j 0.01 / 0.168 / 1.359 / 2.132 s (depth 2 to 5). DATED.

relacional.title: Relational databases and connected data
relacional.summary: Joins, join tables, sparse rows; reciprocal and recursive queries get expensive.

nosql.title: Aggregate NoSQL and connected data; Appendix A
nosql.summary: Aggregates have no first-class relationships; joins happen in the application; ACID vs BASE and quadrants in Appendix A.

cypher.title: Cypher: philosophy, MATCH, RETURN, WHERE, clauses
cypher.summary: Pattern drawn in ASCII; anchors by label and property; clause list on p.49; Neo4j 2.x syntax.

indices.title: Indexes and uniqueness constraints (2.x syntax)
indices.summary: CREATE INDEX ON :Label(prop); CREATE CONSTRAINT ... ASSERT ... IS UNIQUE; without an index the start scans the nodes of the label.

caminho_variavel.title: Variable-length paths and shortestPath
caminho_variavel.summary: Examples *1..5, *1..2, *1..4, *0..2, FORWARD_OF* with no bound; warning about long paths being inefficient (p.136); shortestPath on p.106.

parametros.title: Query parameters
parametros.summary: Examples use {name} (2.x syntax). The book does not discuss plan caching or injection: that is extrapolation.

modelagem.title: Modeling guidelines
modelagem.summary: Nodes for entities, relationships for structure; fine-grained vs generic types; facts as nodes; complex values as nodes.

email.title: Email case: a relationship that loses information
email.summary: EMAILED/CC/BCC between people is lossy; Email nodes with SENT/TO/CC/BCC; replies and forwards as Email:Reply and Email:Forward.

temporal.title: Time: timeline tree, linked lists, versioning, intervals
temporal.summary: Year-Month-Day via MERGE; NEXT/PREVIOUS; versioning leaks into queries; start_date/end_date on relationships in Global Post.

storage.title: Native storage (fixed-size records, doubly linked lists)
storage.summary: Fig. 6-4: 15-byte node and 34-byte relationship (p.171); the text on p.172 says nine bytes (inconsistency); two doubly linked lists per relationship.

cache.title: Page cache (LRU-K, off-heap)
cache.summary: Since Neo4j 2.2, an off-heap LRU-K style cache; sizing: whole store in the page cache, modest heap (4-8 GB is not unusual).

transacoes.title: Transactions, WAL, recovery
transacoes.summary: Write locks on nodes and relationships; deadlock detected and transactions serialized; WAL with idempotent replay. The book does not mention Read Committed.

cluster.title: Master-slave high availability (DATED), scale, sharding
cluster.summary: Master-slave; writing through a slave is slower; cache sharding; sharding in the application; automatic partitioning is NP-hard. Causal Cluster/Raft are not in the book.

arquitetura.title: Embedded vs server, extensions, APIs
arquitetura.summary: Embedded (JVM, application GC) vs server (REST, JSON/HTTP); Core API, Traversal Framework and Cypher.

testes.title: Model and performance testing
testes.summary: Test-driven modeling with small graphs; query and application performance tests; percentiles; representative data.

capacity.title: Capacity planning
capacity.summary: ~6 ms seek; SSD ~20x; heap 4-8 GB; redundancy 3-4 (for 1) or 5 (for 2); concurrent load formula.

importacao.title: Bulk import
importacao.summary: neo4j-import (~1M records/s) and LOAD CSV with MERGE in parts, an index and PERIODIC COMMIT. DATED syntax.

casos.title: Real cases: Talent.net, TeleGraph, Global Post
casos.summary: Inferred social recommendation; authorization with ALLOWED_INHERIT/DENIED; parcel routing by period.

usos.title: Use cases and reasons for adoption
usos.summary: Social, recommendations, geo, MDM, network management and authorization.

algoritmos.title: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, A*
algoritmos.summary: Dijkstra in 5 steps, O(|R| + |N| log |N|); A* with f(n)=g(n)+h(n); Dijkstra in the book via Java (GraphAlgoFactory), p.164.

teoria_social.title: Triadic closure, structural balance, local bridges
teoria_social.summary: Strong triadic closure; balanced closure (all positive or two negative and one positive); local bridges as weak channels.

modelos_de_grafo.title: Hypergraphs and RDF triples
modelos_de_grafo.summary: Hypergraph and property graph are isomorphic; triples are not native and serve analytics.

versao.title: Neo4j and Cypher version of the book
versao.summary: Neo4j 2.2 (2.3 coming soon) in the preface; 2.2 record layout. NEO_START is a 2026 website page with no technical content.

not_in_book.superno: The book does not cover supernodes/dense nodes (only the 'densely connected' flag on p.172). Mitigations are extrapolation.
not_in_book.supernode: The book does not cover supernodes/dense nodes (only the 'densely connected' flag on p.172). Mitigations are extrapolation.
not_in_book.supernos: The book does not cover supernodes/dense nodes (only the 'densely connected' flag on p.172). Mitigations are extrapolation.
not_in_book.no denso: The book does not cover supernodes/dense nodes (only the 'densely connected' flag on p.172). Mitigations are extrapolation.
not_in_book.dense node: The book does not cover supernodes/dense nodes (only the 'densely connected' flag on p.172). Mitigations are extrapolation.
not_in_book.read committed: The book does not mention an isolation level; it says a transaction's writes are not visible to others (p.181).
not_in_book.raft: Raft/Paxos and Causal Clustering are not in the book (Neo4j 2.x master-slave HA). Extrapolation/DATED.
not_in_book.paxos: Raft/Paxos and Causal Clustering are not in the book (Neo4j 2.x master-slave HA). Extrapolation/DATED.
not_in_book.causal cluster: Causal Clustering is not in the book (Neo4j 2.x master-slave HA).
not_in_book.explain: EXPLAIN/PROFILE and plan operators are not in the book.
not_in_book.profile: EXPLAIN/PROFILE and plan operators are not in the book.
not_in_book.allnodesscan: AllNodesScan is not in the book; the book only says that without an index the start scans the nodes of the label (p.66).
not_in_book.allshortestpaths: allShortestPaths is not in the book; shortestPath appears on p.97 and p.106.
not_in_book.pagerank: PageRank, centrality and GDS are not in the book (NEO_START merely lists 'centrality algorithms' as a title, p.2).
not_in_book.gds: Graph Data Science is not in the book (NEO_START merely lists the title, p.2).
not_in_book.apoc: APOC is not in the book.
not_in_book.bolt: Bolt/drivers are not in the book (REST and JAX-RS extensions, p.95-99).
not_in_book.vector: Vector indexes are not in the book (NEO_START merely lists 'Embedding & Vector Indexes', p.2).
not_in_book.optional match: OPTIONAL MATCH is not in the book.
not_in_book.b+: The B+ tree is not mentioned in the book; the book talks about indexes with O(log n) cost (p.168).
not_in_book.k^d: The O(k^d) notation is not in the book; the book uses O(m) and O(m log n) (p.168).
not_in_book.oom: The book does not say an unbounded '*' causes OutOfMemoryError; it only warns about the inefficiency of long paths (p.136).
not_in_book.outofmemory: The book does not say an unbounded '*' causes OutOfMemoryError; it only warns about the inefficiency of long paths (p.136).
not_in_book.dbms.memory: dbms.memory.* parameters are not in the book; the book mentions a 4-8 GB heap and a page cache holding the whole store (p.115).
not_in_book.wait-for: A wait-for graph is not in the book; deadlock is detected and transactions are serialized (p.181).
